name: iceflow-branch-manager
description: IceFlow Branch Manager — multi-branch ice-cream distribution & employee collection system with Ashok AI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
